description: The map's messages: the keys by message number from "first" (the numbers before it are common.json's), and the English text of the original game.

strings.map6_s04.gotta_go_find_cybil_no:
Gotta' go find Cybil!
No time to go back.{end}
strings.map6_s04.dont_talk_ill_take_care:
{wait 3.3}Don't talk.
I'll take care of you.{end}
strings.map6_s04.harry_why_did_they_take:
{wait1 4.8}Harry...
Why did they take your daughter?
strings.map6_s04.but_you_know_cheryl_isnt:
{wait1 4.3}But you know, Cheryl isn't
my biological daughter.
strings.map6_s04.we_found_her_abandoned_on:
{wait1 3.9}We found her abandoned
on the side of the highway.
strings.map6_s04.we_didnt_have_any_kids:
{wait1 3.3}We didn't have any kids
of our own.
strings.map6_s04.and_it_didnt_look_like:
{wait1 3.4}and it didn't look like
she was getting any better.
strings.map6_s04.there_might_be_some_connection:
{wait1 5.2}There might be some connection
between Cheryl and this town.{end}
strings.map6_s04.cheryl_is_my_daughter_i:
{wait1 3.5}Cheryl is my daughter.
I will save her.
strings.map6_s04.what_in_the_hell_how:
{wait 6.0}What in the hell...
How could this have happened?{end}
strings.map6_s04.i_dont_know_who_you:
{wait1 4.0}I don't know who you are,
what you are trying to do,
and I don't care.
strings.map6_s04.let_cheryl_go_thats_all:
{wait1 3.1}Let Cheryl go.
That's all I ask.{end}
strings.map6_s04.this_is_the_end_of:
{wait1 4.0}This is the end of
your little game.
strings.map6_s04.youve_been_a_ghastly_little:
{wait1 4.6}You've been a ghastly little pest,
haven't you?  Alessa?
strings.map6_s04.thinking_you_couldnt_escape:
{wait1 3.5}Thinking you couldn't escape
from our spell.
strings.map6_s04.but_mommy_didnt_know_how:
{wait1 4.5}But Mommy didn't know
how much you'd grown.
strings.map6_s04.thats_why_i_couldnt_catch:
{wait1 4.3}That's why I couldn't catch you
all by myself.
strings.map6_s04.now_youre_half_indebted_to:
{wait1 5.0}Now you're half indebted
to this man for his help.
strings.map6_s04.everything_is_ready_lets_go:
{wait 5.1}Everything is ready.
Let's go home now.{end}
